business.name: Alder & Ash Architecture
business.tagline: Homes shaped by light, land, and life.
business.description: A hypothetical residential architecture studio serving Asheville and Western North Carolina with new-home design, renovation planning, and interior architecture.
business.offer: Bring the site, the questions, and the constraints that matter.

services.name: Residential architecture
services.description: Plan a new home around its site, daily routines, and long-term use.

services.name: Renovation planning
services.description: Rework an existing home with a clear understanding of constraints and priorities.

services.name: Interior architecture
services.description: Coordinate rooms, circulation, materials, and built elements as one spatial system.

services.name: Site studies
services.description: Study access, orientation, views, and context before the design direction is set.

faqs.question: What should I bring to a first conversation?
faqs.answer: Share the property location, any available plans or surveys, and the priorities or constraints already shaping the decision.

faqs.question: Can we begin before purchasing a property?
faqs.answer: A site study can help frame questions about access, orientation, context, and the kind of home the property may support.

faqs.question: Do you work beyond Asheville?
faqs.answer: The studio serves submitted project areas across Western North Carolina and confirms fit and availability for each property.
